title: Ordinary bifunctor comparison squares extend to signed direct-sum totals
statement: Let A,B,D be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with small coproducts [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Give bifunctors FA:A×A→A, FB:B×B→B and FD:D×D→D preserving zero morphisms separately in both variables. Write TotF for the signed direct-sum total on integer-indexed cochain complexes induced by F, whose degree n is the coproduct over a+b=n. Let C:A→B, U:B→D and I:A→D be additive functors, with U an equivalence. Suppose alpha:CU≅I and alphaC:C_Ch U_Ch≅I_Ch have matching components in every degree. Give ordinary isomorphisms muC:C(FA(M,N))≅FB(CM,CN) and muI:I(FA(M,N))≅FD(IM,IN). Give chain isomorphisms tC:TotFB(CP,CQ)≅C_Ch TotFA(P,Q) and tI:TotFD(IP,IQ)≅I_Ch TotFA(P,Q), whose composites with each bidegree injection are muC^{-1} followed by C of that injection, and muI^{-1} followed by I of that injection, respectively. Give maps delta:U(FB(M,N))→FD(UM,UN) and a natural chain isomorphism sigma:TotFB U_Ch≅(U_Ch×U_Ch)TotFD satisfying the bidegree formula U(iota);sigma=delta;iota. Assume the ordinary square U(muC^{-1});alpha=delta;FD(alpha,alpha);muI^{-1} for every pair of objects of A. Then alphaC_TotFA(P,Q);tI(P,Q)^{-1}=U_Ch(tC(P,Q)^{-1});sigma_CP,CQ;TotFD(alphaC_P,alphaC_Q) for every pair of unbounded cochain complexes P,Q. The tensor case is obtained by taking FA,FB,FD to be the ordinary tensor bifunctors.

proof.text: Cancel the mapped tC.hom on the source and tI.hom on the target. The inverse identities leave the forward square. Equality of chain maps can be checked in each degree. U is an equivalence, hence preserves the coproduct in that degree. Check the maps after precomposing with U of each bidegree injection.

Use the tC summand equation and functoriality of U. The component equation for alphaC and naturality of alpha move the coproduct injection through alpha. Substitute the assumed ordinary square. On the other side, the sigma summand equation, the bifunctor-map injection formula, the tI summand equation and the component equation for alphaC give exactly the same composite. Associativity finishes the equality on each summand. The preserved-coproduct universal property and chain-map extensionality prove the result. Zero complexes and empty sums require no separate assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorTotalComparisonSquare
    (alpha : C ⋙ U ≅ I)
    (alphaC : C.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      I.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
    (halpha : ∀ (P : CochainComplex A ℤ) (n : ℤ),
      (alphaC.hom.app P).f n = alpha.hom.app (P.X n))
    (muC : ∀ M N : A,
      C.obj ((FA.obj M).obj N) ≅ (FB.obj (C.obj M)).obj (C.obj N))
    (muI : ∀ M N : A,
      I.obj ((FA.obj M).obj N) ≅ (FD.obj (I.obj M)).obj (I.obj N))
    (tC : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex A ℤ,
      (Tot[FB]).obj (((C.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P),
        ((C.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)) ≅
          (C.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj ((Tot[FA]).obj (P, Q)))
    (tI : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex A ℤ,
      (Tot[FD]).obj (((I.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P),
        ((I.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)) ≅
          (I.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj ((Tot[FA]).obj (P, Q)))
    (htC : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex A ℤ) (a b n : ℤ) (h : a + b = n),
      CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor ((C.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          ((C.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) FB a b n h ≫ (tC P Q).hom.f n =
        (muC (P.X a) (Q.X b)).inv ≫
          C.map (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q FA a b n h))
    (htI : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex A ℤ) (a b n : ℤ) (h : a + b = n),
      CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor ((I.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          ((I.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) FD a b n h ≫ (tI P Q).hom.f n =
        (muI (P.X a) (Q.X b)).inv ≫
          I.map (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q FA a b n h))
    (delta : ∀ M N : B, U.obj ((FB.obj M).obj N) ⟶ (FD.obj (U.obj M)).obj (U.obj N))
    (sigma : (Tot[FB]) ⋙ U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
        (Tot[FD]))
    (hsigma : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex B ℤ) (a b n : ℤ) (h : a + b = n),
      U.map (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q FB a b n h) ≫
          (sigma.hom.app (P, Q)).f n =
        delta (P.X a) (Q.X b) ≫
          CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) FD a b n h)
    (hordinary : ∀ M N : A,
      U.map (muC M N).inv ≫ alpha.hom.app ((FA.obj M).obj N) =
        delta (C.obj M) (C.obj N) ≫
          (FD.map (alpha.hom.app M)).app (U.obj (C.obj N)) ≫
            (FD.obj (I.obj M)).map (alpha.hom.app N) ≫ (muI M N).inv)
    (P Q : CochainComplex A ℤ) :
    alphaC.hom.app ((Tot[FA]).obj (P, Q)) ≫ (tI P Q).inv =
      (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (tC P Q).inv ≫
        sigma.hom.app (((C.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P),
          ((C.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)) ≫
            (Tot[FD]).map (Prod.mkHom (alphaC.hom.app P) (alphaC.hom.app Q))
